Name: Example intracellular ephys data from LNMC & BBP
Description:
This is a single session showing example intracellular electrophysiology data collected at the Laboratory of Neural Microcircuitry, EPFL. This session holds a variety of different stimulation patterns. 

It also serves as an example of the hierarchy of metadata tables (/general/intracellular_ephys/) and groups (/data_organization) storing sweeps of a complex experimental protocol.

Load this file in pynwb with load_namespaces = True.
